name: Tm Visualization Suite: Distribution Explorer
pitch: See the full spread of your values, not just the average, and find the groups that behave differently.
question: How are my values spread, and what hides behind the average?
useWhen: Show how values spread inside and between groups.
features: Add the raw values next to the shape
See how many fall below each level
Count the values in every bin

hero.alt: Violin charts of basket value for twelve groups of delivery method and channel, each with a box inside.
hero.caption: The full shape of every group, not just its average

screenshots.alt: Violin charts of basket value for web shop orders, one violin for each delivery method and customer group.
screenshots.caption: Select a channel and every violin shows only its orders

screenshots.alt: Raincloud chart of lead time for home delivery, points on the left and a density with a box on the right.
screenshots.caption: Select one group and the raincloud shows its own spread

questions: Do customers in one channel spend very differently?
How long do deliveries really take?
audience: Analysts and BI leads who look beyond the average to the full spread of a number.

featureStrips.heading: Add the raw values next to the shape
featureStrips.text: A raincloud draws the density, a box and the single points together, so shape and detail sit side by side.
featureStrips.alt: Raincloud chart for four delivery methods with points on the left and a half violin and box on the right.

featureStrips.heading: Show every single value
featureStrips.text: A beeswarm spreads the points so none hide behind another, and clusters and outliers stay visible.
featureStrips.alt: Beeswarm chart of basket value for four customer groups, dots spread to show each value.

featureStrips.heading: See how many fall below each level
featureStrips.text: A cumulative curve answers questions like how many deliveries arrive within 24 hours.
featureStrips.alt: Cumulative curves of lead time in hours, one line for each of nine regions, rising to 100 percent.

featureStrips.heading: Count the values in every bin
featureStrips.text: A dot histogram stacks one dot per value in each bin, so you see the shape and the exact counts.
featureStrips.alt: Dot histogram of lead time in hours for four delivery methods, with one dot per delivery stacked in bins.
